titulo.estudio: Lire un horaire : Repérer les informations

intro: Match activity and time in a daily timetable. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Match activity and time in a daily timetable. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: « De… à… » marks the interval and « le » can indicate the days on which an activity repeats. In this passage, «lundi» means «Monday».

frases.estudio: La bibliothèque ouvre à neuf heures du lundi au vendredi.
frases.alumno: The library opens at nine o'clock from Monday to Friday.

frases.estudio: Le mercredi, l'atelier de lecture commence à quinze heures.
frases.alumno: On Wednesday, the reading workshop starts at three in the afternoon.
